# Generated by mods/cm_dev_perf/tools/port_from_cm_dev.py; not to be edited by hand.
# The player's governor placement map, kept from CM's own governor planner (+perf27): the
# planner's monthly search writes the same cm_gf_* the map draws. See _pf_view_effects.

# Root is the country. Before the planner's first search of a tick.
cm_perf_pf_view_save = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_saved }
		}
		set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_saved value = 1 }
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_view_g
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_view_c
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_fresh_g
		if = { limit = { exists = var:cm_pf_view_g } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_view_g value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { exists = var:cm_pf_view_c } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_view_c value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { exists = var:cm_pf_fresh_g } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_fresh_g value = 1 } }
		every_owned_location = {
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_score
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_score } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_score value = var:cm_gf_score } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_avg
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_avg } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_avg value = var:cm_gf_avg } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_taxgain
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_taxgain } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_taxgain value = var:cm_gf_taxgain } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_popgain
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_popgain } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_popgain value = var:cm_gf_popgain } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_top
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_top } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_top value = var:cm_gf_top } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_localmax
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_localmax } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_localmax value = var:cm_gf_localmax } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_skip
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_skip } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_skip value = var:cm_gf_skip } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_inelig
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_inelig } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_inelig value = var:cm_gf_inelig } }
			remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_nogain
			if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_gf_nogain } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_pfv_nogain value = var:cm_gf_nogain } }
		}
	}
}

# Root is the country. At the end of every planner tick. The viewed-mode flags always come
# back; the scores wait while the planner is on classify (phase 4), which reads its own.
cm_perf_pf_view_restore = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_saved }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:cm_perf_pfv_view_g }
			set_variable = { name = cm_pf_view_g value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:cm_perf_pfv_view_c }
			set_variable = { name = cm_pf_view_c value = 1 }
		}
		# The planner's scores stand until classify, which strips them with the fresh flag; the
		# view comes back at the end of that tick.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:cm_gov_phase = 4 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				remove_variable = cm_gf_score
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_score } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_score value = var:cm_perf_pfv_score } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_score
				remove_variable = cm_gf_avg
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_avg } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_avg value = var:cm_perf_pfv_avg } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_avg
				remove_variable = cm_gf_taxgain
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_taxgain } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_taxgain value = var:cm_perf_pfv_taxgain } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_taxgain
				remove_variable = cm_gf_popgain
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_popgain } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_popgain value = var:cm_perf_pfv_popgain } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_popgain
				remove_variable = cm_gf_top
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_top } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_top value = var:cm_perf_pfv_top } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_top
				remove_variable = cm_gf_localmax
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_localmax } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_localmax value = var:cm_perf_pfv_localmax } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_localmax
				remove_variable = cm_gf_skip
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_skip } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_skip value = var:cm_perf_pfv_skip } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_skip
				remove_variable = cm_gf_inelig
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_inelig } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_inelig value = var:cm_perf_pfv_inelig } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_inelig
				remove_variable = cm_gf_nogain
				if = { limit = { has_variable = cm_perf_pfv_nogain } set_variable = { name = cm_gf_nogain value = var:cm_perf_pfv_nogain } }
				remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_nogain
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:cm_perf_pfv_fresh_g }
				set_variable = { name = cm_pf_fresh_g value = 1 days = 1460 }
			}
			else = {
				remove_variable = cm_pf_fresh_g
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = var:cm_pf_mode_open }
				set_variable = { name = cm_pf_repaint value = 1 }
			}
			cm_perf_pf_view_drop = yes
		}
	}
}

# Root is the country. A run of the player's own is newer than anything saved.
cm_perf_pf_view_drop = {
	remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_saved
	remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_view_g
	remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_view_c
	remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_fresh_g
	every_owned_location = {
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_score
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_avg
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_taxgain
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_popgain
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_top
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_localmax
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_skip
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_inelig
		remove_variable = cm_perf_pfv_nogain
	}
}
